title: Causes and Follow-up Actions for March 2026 Disruptions on Singtel’s Mobile Network
what_it_is: Causes and Follow-up Actions for March 2026 Disruptions on Singtel’s Mobile Network

sections.label: Singtel March incident details
sections.summary: An incident on 16 March affected over 600,000 Singtel mobile customers, lasted about nine hours, and was attributed to a mechanical fault.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Based on preliminary reports, an incident on 16 March affected more than 600,000 Singtel mobile customers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: While services were progressively recovered, the disruption lasted for about nine hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The cause of the incident was attributed to a mechanical fault at one of Singtel’s network facilities.

sections.label: IMDA reviewing resilience regulations
sections.summary: IMDA is reviewing telecom service resilience regulations to ensure they remain effective.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: IMDA is reviewing telecom service resilience regulations to ensure they remain effective.

sections.label: Incident links and cyber evidence
sections.summary: Relations between incidents are not firmly established, and there is no evidence any reported incidents were cyber-related.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We do not rule out entirely that the incidents are related in some way, but the extent of the relations is yet to be firmly established, so it is better to let the investigators complete their work.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It is clear, however, that, for now, there is no evidence to suggest that any of the incidents that have been reported were cyber-related.

sections.label: Incident frequency and duration trends
sections.summary: Average incidents fell from eight per year in 2016-2020 to six in 2021-2025, and average duration fell from eight to six-and-a-half hours.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If we look at five-year blocks, it was an average of eight incidents in the period 2016 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In the more recent five-year period, 2021 to 2025, that has come down to an average of six incidents per year.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The average duration of the incidents has also come down from eight hours to six-and-a-half hours.

sections.label: Overseas compensation rules and suggestion
sections.summary: Regulators in two countries require compensation with limited scope, which the March Singtel incidents would not have qualified for, and the suggestion will be looked at.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In these two countries, the regulators require compensation, but the scope is quite limited, such as for loss of service for broadband or landline only, which the incidents that took place in March for Singtel, would also not have qualified.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We are prepared to look at the suggestion.

sections.label: Regulations reducing incidents, further review
sections.summary: Regulations have helped reduce incident numbers and average duration, and IMDA with CSA will look seriously into strengthening them.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The other thing is that in response to the earlier question by Mr Melvin Yong, I had cited how the regulations have also helped to reduce the number of incidents as well as the average duration per incident.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And we will continue to look at how regulations can be strengthened in support of such improvements.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The short answer is that IMDA, together with CSA, will have to look very seriously into these issues.
